scope: Historical distribution upper bounds for retained original message variants; not exact archive webpage publication times, actor authority, or component/outcome coding.
standard_judgment: For an original variant in the accepted public development-list export, matching List-ID, Delivered-To mailing-list identity, explicit archive-asf-public recipient, and a parseable Receiving-hop stamp by mx-eu-03.ponee.io jointly establish public distribution no later than that receiving stamp. The receiving timestamp, not the earlier outgoing ASF queue timestamp, supplies the bound. Original Date/index epochs are not substituted. Source hashes and original header locators must accompany any decisive use.
human_checks: Representative original headers for all four project lists inspected.
All seven observed receiving-hop transport classes inspected, preserving literal recipient/receiver and parsed dates.

Five Tailscale-HELO variants checked individually: receiver stamp still names mxout1-ec2-va.apache.org peer3.227.148.255 and underlying ASF mail relay; no organizational role inferred from a hostname.
All53fallback original Date/List-ID/first receiving headers independently inspected after an oversized initial output was truncated. Full53replacement display read without truncation.
unknown_judgment: The53fallback variants carry archiver@mbox-vm.apache.org receiving stamps rather than explicit archive-asf-public/Ponee delivery. They establish transport/archiver receipt, but historical public availability remains unknown without separate corroboration. Do not infer missing public availability, exclusion, late publication, or refusal from this route difference.
limits: This provenance judgment relies on the integrity of the accepted official public archive and retained transport headers; it is not independent cryptographic timestamp authentication. It does not certify historical webpage versions, absent private pressure or an individual role. Current GitHub/Jira representations remain separately bounded.
variant_rules: Keep allraw/body variants. For a source ID with multiple required variants, every decisive variant must have a qualifying bound; never use the earliest old variant to authenticate a later body.
